verdict.rationale: Bruno can run collections unattended through its CLI, which is documented for CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions and official Docker images, and it produces JSON, JUnit and HTML reports. However, background autonomy depends on external pipeline or scheduler tooling: no native scheduling, monitors or background agent automations are evidenced. Its AI features are interactive, review-and-accept generation rather than autonomous runs. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/monitors, native background or agentic automation runs, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
